parameter_fingerprints.random: differ from ORCD in all five seeds
parameter_fingerprints.cause: CPU-vendor-dependent last-bit rounding of log/exp/expm1 in FLA's A_log and dt_bias initialization; every other parameter is bit-identical
evidence: Seed 0 on AMD EPYC (dogo, jobs 201752-201754) gives the Kennel fingerprint under every ATen CPU capability (default, AVX2, AVX512), MKL_CBWR (COMPATIBLE, SSE4_2, AVX2, AVX512), MKL_DEBUG_CPU_TYPE=5, a dirtied allocator, and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
Seed 0 on Intel Xeon Gold 5218R (doodle, job 201762) reproduces the ORCD fingerprint 0415b698...0c65bd exactly.
Seeds 0-4, Intel (doodle, 201763) versus AMD (mastiff, 201764; bit-identical to dogo for seed 0): 10-22 of 384 A_log/dt_bias elements per seed differ, each by 1 ULP.
parameter_fingerprints.consequence: random DeltaNet metrics deviate from ORCD no more than the pretrained condition, whose parameters are identical (both <=5.6e-7 relative)

unified_analysis.differences: only the DeltaNet random-seed1 layer-23 threshold rank above; terminal comparison counts unchanged
